### Selected Projects
*Full write-ups at [mcooperjay.github.io/projects](https://mcooperjay.github.io/projects/index.html)*

**Causal Inference: ICU Treatment Effects** — Estimated the causal effect of a diagnostic procedure on patient survival using propensity score matching, correcting a naive comparison that had the effect sign backwards due to confounding by indication.

**Functional Data Analysis: Wildfire Severity Forecasting** — Applied a historical functional linear model to 30 years of national wildfire records, modeling monthly area-burned as a function of prior fire-count curves; outperformed an unrestricted baseline model.

**Spatial Epidemiology: Heat-Illness Risk Mapping (Houston, TX)** — Built a conditional autoregressive (CAR) model of heat-related illness risk from census-tract demographic and climate data; delivered a public-facing risk map and prevention poster.

**Time Series Forecasting: Company Growth** — Compared linear regression, ARIMA, Prophet, and spline-based models for forecasting quarterly growth from macroeconomic indicators, evaluated by out-of-sample RMSE.
